links.comparator_used: Conventional full-recording visual review by an expert panel of three readers
links.outcome: Time to diagnostic decision, interrater reliability and sensitivity in adult long-term EEG monitoring
links.effect: Median review time 2.2 [.5-4.3] vs 52.4 [33.2-62.9] min (95.8% median reduction, p < .001). Interrater reliability AC1 .81 vs .43 (p < .001). Sensitivity .88 vs .69 (adjusted p = .006). Accuracy .75 vs .68, nonsignificant after correction (adjusted p > .99).
links.quote: Review time was markedly reduced (median [interquartile range (IQR)] = 2.2 [.5-4.3] vs. 52.4 [33.2-62.9] min, mean [95% CI] = 2.9 [2.5-3.2] vs. 50.8 [46.5-55.2] min, p < .001), a 95.8% median reduction (IQR = 95.6-96.3).

design_hint: expert clinician review of AI detections (hybrid approach)
